CustomField.description: Used for SMS campaigns. US phone numbers are 10 characters in length. International numbers are 15 characters in length. A validation rule will check to be sure there are only numeric characters in the field. [MDM] - Read
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Mobile number (digits only) for recruitment mass texting messages. Field represents an initial opt-in, contact must also opt in via text and may opt out at any time (text STOP in response), opt out status is tracked only in Silverpop, not visible here.
CustomField.label: SMS Mobile Phone Opt In
